treaty_name: Agreement between the Arab Republic of Egypt and the Hellenic Republic for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (2004)
eif_quote: 3 Agreement between the Hellenic Republic and the Arab Republic of Egypt for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital Egypt Original 27-11-2004 23-08-2006
source_title: ETA: Synthesised text of the MLI and the Egypt-Greece Agreement (English)

rates.quote: 2. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that state, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: The following paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI applies and supersedes the provisions of this Agreement: ... a benefit under [the Agreement] shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude ... that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction ... | '(i) with respect to taxes withheld at source on amounts paid or credited to non-residents, where the event giving rise to such taxes occurs on or after 1 January 2022'.

notes: Single dividend rate 10% (no participation tier); MLI Art. 8 irrelevant and in any case Greece 'reserves the right for the entirety of Article 8 not to apply'. Art. 11(3): interest paid to the other State, its local authorities or its Central Bank exempt - not modelled. Art. 29(2)(a): WHT applies to amounts paid or credited on/after 1 January of the year following EIF (2006-08-23 -> 2007-01-01). Greece notified the choice of Art. 7(7)(b) (relevant only to the simplified LOB); the PPT applies. Greek national text (FEK) not accessed (Greek government sites returned 403 per treaty map); rates from Egypt's official ETA synthesised English text (English prevails).
